reapack.name: Jay-JayDev_Open ReaMenuHelper.lua
reapack.desc: ReaMenu Helper - drag-and-drop editor for REAPER's menus

metadata.description: Drag-and-drop editor for REAPER's menus (main menu and context menus), replacing the native editor. Launches ReaMenuHelper.html in your default browser. Project in Beta.

version.name: 0.1.0-beta4
version.author: Jay-JayDev
version.changelog: Renamed the launcher script from "Jay-JayDev_Apri ReaMenuHelper.lua" to "Jay-JayDev_Open ReaMenuHelper.lua" — it was still Italian ("Apri" = "Open") despite the rest of the UI being translated to English.

version.name: 0.1.0-beta3
version.author: Jay-JayDev
version.changelog: Fix: the data folder is now looked up in Scripts\Jay-JayDev\ReaMenu Helper\Data, the real path where ReaPack installs the package (non-empty category, as required by ReaPack). Fixes the "Data folder not found" and "empty category name" errors. UI fully translated to English.
